items.rationale: The failed indoor heating pipe falls under §2.4.3(a), assuming escape-of-water cover is scheduled. Four matching repair fittings at €10 each are allowable under §7.1.7(c).

Section 7.1.7(c) allows matching fittings at about €18 each, or €90 for five. Section 7.1.8(e) requires a link to the repair; the listed replacement tube is 15 mm, and the claim does not confirm work on a 28 mm connection.
Allow €18 under §7.1.7(c) if this fitting was used at a 28 mm connection on the repaired run. Section 7.1.8(e) excludes it if that connection cannot be tied to the repair.
Minor repair fixings are allowable under §7.1.7(c) without an item-by-item match under §7.1.8(e). Eight screws at about €1.25 each total €10.
Supports needed to refit the repaired heating run qualify as fastenings under §7.1.7(c). Four clamps at about €5 each total €20.

Like-for-like copper is covered under §§2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) to the extent used on the failed run. At roughly €12 per metre, the billed 6.4 metres total €77 if attributable to that repair under §7.1.8(e).
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for the pipe repair, not time spent on unrelated jobs under §7.1.5. The gross benchmark for the 6.75-hour plumbing line is €566.
Necessary helper time on the pipe repair is covered by §7.1.7(g), but any time spent on the other jobs is excluded under §7.1.5. The gross benchmark for 5.75 hours is €394.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the original insulation on the repaired section. The gross benchmark for six pieces is €146.
Wire used to secure the replacement insulation is a covered consumable under §7.1.7(c). Allow about €16 for 2 kg if used on the repair rather than charged as unused stock under §7.1.8(e).
Section 7.1.8(e) permits a lump sum for genuine repair consumables, but §7.1.8(c) bars duplication of separately billed materials. Allow €24 for additional consumables used on the pipe repair.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the contractor's first travel charge on the invoice. This is the only one shown, and the gross benchmark is €80.

Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of removed pipe and insulation, not waste from the undamaged storage-room floor. Allow the €62 benchmark for the pipe-repair debris if it can be attributed to the covered work.
The hallway was not affected, so §§3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude all 12 m² even though the same contractor performed the work. The figure is a conditional price estimate only.
The leak never reached the storage room, so §§7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude all 15 m² as work in a separate, undamaged room. The figure is a conditional price estimate only.
The tap service was unrelated maintenance, excluded by §§7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a). The figure is a conditional price estimate only.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate administrative and processing charges. The figure is a conditional price estimate only.
